text: Sigmall is an Irish hero. He is the grandson of the fairy king Midir. His mother is Ogniad, the lawless daughter of Midir. The tale is thin in the record. Scholars do not agree on every part of it. Midir's consort Étain may or may not be Sigmall's grandmother. The stories do not settle the question. What they do say is that Étain lives now and forever in the Otherworld with Sigmall. The hero keeps a place beside the fairy queen in the world beyond the mortal. Their bond outlasts the court of Midir.
